name: Paul
note: The apostle, once a persecutor, now defending the gospel of grace.

name: The believers in Galatia
note: Gentile Christians being pressed to be circumcised.

name: The agitators
note: Teachers who "trouble" the Galatians and want them to be circumcised; Paul does not name them.

name: Cephas (Peter)
note: The apostle Simon Peter, whom Paul visited and later confronted in Antioch.

name: James, the Lord's brother
note: A leader of the Jerusalem church.

name: Barnabas
note: Paul's partner, who was swept along by the pressure in Antioch.

name: Titus
note: A Greek believer who was not forced to be circumcised.

name: Abraham
note: The father of the faithful, justified by faith.

name: Jesus
note: The crucified Messiah who redeemed us from the curse of the law.

name: The "false brothers"
note: People who slipped into the Jerusalem meeting to spy on the freedom Gentile believers had (2:4).

name: John
note: One of the three "pillars" of the Jerusalem church with James and Cephas.

name: The circumcision party
note: Those who insisted on circumcision, whose disapproval made Peter withdraw from the Gentiles at Antioch.

name: Moses
note: Through whom the law came, 430 years after the promise to Abraham.

name: Hagar
note: Sarah's slave woman, mother of Ishmael; in Paul's picture she stands for Mount Sinai.

name: Sarah
note: Abraham's wife, the free woman and mother of the child of promise.

name: Isaac
note: The child of promise, born according to the Spirit.

name: Ishmael
note: Abraham's son by Hagar, born according to the flesh.
